$comment: To add a caution, a pharmacist edits this file only: add or reuse a closed vocabulary under cautionVocabularies (one entry per medicine or concept: Chinese and English generic names and brand names in one array), add a rule under cautionRules — `when` lists the groups that must all be present in the question or the report, `mention` the terms whose absence from the report is the finding, `messageZh` what the reader is told to add, `evidence` the authority — and add at least one positive and one negative case to packages/domain/test/fixtures/clinical-safety-cautions.json. Terms are compared whole, never as patterns. Cautions are advisory: they never withhold a delivery. The TCM rules (family tcm-incompatibility) are generated by scripts/build/generate-tcm-caution-rules.mjs from the curated 十八反十九畏 matrix; edit the matrix, not them.
description: Drug- and scenario-specific clinical safety rules for the clinical-evidence-synthesis quality gate. Kept as data so pharmacists can review, add, or retire medicine/scenario rules without changing server code. Each pattern is a JavaScript regular-expression source. Generic, non-drug-specific safety rules (emergency-call support, exclusive-safety language) stay in clinicalEvidenceQuality.mjs. Supported kinds: report_forbidden (forbid a pattern in the whole report, after optional substitutions), practical_forbidden (forbid a pattern in the safety-first practical section), entity_requires_question_mention (an entity may appear in the report only if the user's question mentions it), practical_required_when_report_matches (when triggerPattern appears anywhere in the report, pattern must appear in the practical section).
routingEntitiesNote: High-risk medicines whose plain mention (with an evidence/analysis intent) routes an open-domain question to clinical-evidence-synthesis, so these safety rules are actually applied. specialistRouting.mjs reads this list; add a medicine here to bring its questions under the clinical gate.
highRiskEntitiesNote: A closed, pharmacist-maintained vocabulary of high-alert medicines. Naming one of these in a deliverable that is NOT under a clinical contract raises an advisory notice (check clinical-high-risk-entity), never a rejection: a bibliometric study of metformin literature is legitimately about metformin and must not be withheld for saying so. routingEntities above is the blocking half of the same idea and stays deliberately small - every name there also blocks in packages/socket's completion check, over every file in the workspace. Promoting a name from this list to routingEntities is therefore a decision to spend part of the blocking budget, and needs the observed notice distribution first (development principle 4).

rules.message: Medication response must not be presented as a way to diagnose or exclude the cause of chest symptoms. State instead that relief after a sublingual dose does not distinguish cardiac from non-cardiac pain, cite the evidence for that, and say that persisting symptoms call for emergency assessment regardless of the response.

The practical answer must not add unsupported advice about antacids or waiting for symptom changes. Give only steps carried by a cited claim; if a step seems clinically sensible but has no source in this package, leave it out and say the evidence was not retrieved.
A medicine-free question must not introduce Suxiao Jiuxin Wan into the report. Answer the question that was asked; if the medicine is genuinely relevant, the reader has to raise it.

rules.pattern: (?:(?:速效救心丸|任何(?:自救)?药物|任何急救药|含服(?:任何)?药物).{0,120}(?:不应|不能|不得|不要|不可|不构成|不作为).{0,50}(?:延误|延迟|推迟|耽误|替代).{0,30}(?:呼救|急救|就医|评估|120|呼叫)|(?:不应|不能|不得|不要|不可|不构成|不作为).{0,50}(?:因|以|让|为了)?.{0,30}(?:速效救心丸|任何(?:自救)?药物|任何急救药|含服(?:任何)?药物).{0,60}(?:延误|延迟|推迟|耽误|替代).{0,30}(?:呼救|急救|就医|评估|120|呼叫))
rules.message: The practical answer must explicitly state that Suxiao Jiuxin Wan must not delay emergency care. Add that sentence to the practical section — taking it is not a reason to wait, and emergency services should be called at the same time, not after.

cautionVocabulariesNote: Closed vocabularies for cautionRules, referred to as @name. An array entry is one concept under several names, so two names of one medicine never count as two medicines.

acei-arb: 血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂
血管紧张素受体拮抗剂
血管紧张素II受体拮抗剂
ssri-snri: 选择性5-羟色胺再摄取抑制剂
5-羟色胺和去甲肾上腺素再摄取抑制剂
potassium-sparing: 盐皮质激素受体拮抗剂

cautionRulesNote: Advisory cautions (check clinical-safety-cautions): when the question or report sets the scene (`when`, every group) and the report never uses a caution term (`mention`), the run is advised and the reader is shown a SAFETY notice. Never a reason to withhold a delivery (owner decision 5, 2026-09-18).

cautionRules.titleZh: 阿司匹林一级预防：出血风险
cautionRules.message: The report discusses aspirin for primary prevention and never mentions bleeding. State the bleeding risk it adds (gastrointestinal and intracranial) and that the net benefit depends on the person's bleeding risk.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论阿司匹林用于一级预防，但通篇没有提到出血风险。请写明它增加的出血风险（消化道出血、颅内出血），以及净获益取决于个体的出血风险。

evidence.authority: ASPREE trial, N Engl J Med 2018;379:1509
evidence.quote: significantly higher risk of major hemorrhage and did not result in a significantly lower risk of cardiovascular disease

evidence.authority: ACC/AHA Guideline on the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease
evidence.quote: adults of any age who are at increased risk of bleeding
evidence.note: Class III: Harm (C-LD) for low-dose aspirin in primary prevention.

evidence.authority: 中国心血管病一级预防指南
evidence.quote: 出血高危险因素包括但不限于以下情况：既往有胃肠道出血或消化性溃疡疾病

evidence.authority: USPSTF
evidence.quote: The USPSTF recommends against initiating low-dose aspirin use for the primary prevention of CVD in adults 60 years or older.

cautionRules.titleZh: 老年人阿司匹林一级预防：指南立场
cautionRules.message: The report discusses aspirin for primary prevention in older adults and never states the guideline position: routine initiation is not recommended (USPSTF 2022: 60 and over; ACC/AHA 2019 and the 2020 Chinese primary-prevention guideline: over 70; AGS Beers 2023: avoid initiating). State that position and its trial basis (ASPREE).
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论老年人使用阿司匹林进行一级预防，但没有写出指南立场：不推荐常规启用（USPSTF 2022：60 岁及以上；ACC/AHA 2019 与《中国心血管病一级预防指南》2020：70 岁以上；AGS Beers 2023：避免启用）。请写明这一立场及其试验依据（ASPREE）。

evidence.authority: USPSTF
evidence.quote: The USPSTF recommends against initiating low-dose aspirin use for the primary prevention of CVD in adults 60 years or older.
evidence.note: Grade D.

evidence.authority: ACC/AHA Guideline on the Primary Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease
evidence.quote: should not be administered on a routine basis for the primary prevention of ASCVD among adults >70 years of age
evidence.note: Class III: Harm (B-R).

evidence.authority: 中国心血管病一级预防指南
evidence.quote: 使用阿司匹林进行 ASCVD一级预防时，对于年龄>70岁的患者其风险大于获益，不建议常规使用

evidence.authority: ASPREE trial, N Engl J Med 2018;379:1509
evidence.quote: significantly higher risk of major hemorrhage and did not result in a significantly lower risk of cardiovascular disease

evidence.authority: AGS Beers Criteria
evidence.quote: Avoid initiating aspirin for primary prevention of cardiovascular disease.

cautionRules.titleZh: 抗凝药合用抗血小板药或 NSAID：出血
cautionRules.message: The report discusses an anticoagulant together with an antiplatelet agent or an NSAID and never mentions bleeding. State that the combination raises the risk of major bleeding, and what monitoring or gastroprotection applies.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论抗凝药与抗血小板药或非甾体抗炎药同用，但没有提到出血。请写明联用会增加大出血风险，以及相应的监测或胃肠保护措施。

evidence.authority: Eliquis (apixaban) prescribing information
evidence.quote: Concomitant use of drugs affecting hemostasis increases the risk of bleeding.

evidence.authority: Xarelto (rivaroxaban) prescribing information
evidence.quote: Coadministration of enoxaparin, warfarin, aspirin, clopidogrel and chronic NSAID use may increase the risk of bleeding

evidence.authority: Warfarin sodium tablets prescribing information (Teva)
evidence.quote: can cause major or fatal bleeding
evidence.note: Boxed warning; Table 3 of the label lists antiplatelet agents and NSAIDs among the drugs that raise the bleeding risk.

evidence.authority: AGS Beers Criteria
evidence.quote: Avoid short-term scheduled use in combination with oral or parenteral corticosteroids, anticoagulants, or antiplatelet agents unless other alternatives are not effective
evidence.note: The NSAID row. Beers 2023 has no anticoagulant-with-antiplatelet entry of its own; that half of the caution rests on the labels above.

cautionRules.titleZh: 肾病患者使用 NSAID：肾损伤
cautionRules.message: The report discusses NSAIDs in people with kidney disease and never mentions the renal risk. State that NSAIDs can cause acute kidney injury and hasten CKD progression, that prolonged use should be avoided, and that renal function needs monitoring.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论肾病患者使用非甾体抗炎药，但没有提到肾脏风险。请写明 NSAID 可致急性肾损伤、加速慢性肾病进展，应避免长期使用，并需监测肾功能。

evidence.authority: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of CKD
evidence.quote: Prolonged therapy is not recommended in people with GFR <60
evidence.note: Table 32, which also advises avoiding NSAIDs at GFR <30 ml/min/1.73 m2 and with lithium or RAAS blockade.

evidence.authority: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of CKD
evidence.quote: Indiscriminate chronic OTC NSAID use has been associated with a higher risks of kidney failure
evidence.note: Page S247; the 2024 guideline discourages chronic over-the-counter use rather than repeating the 2012 GFR thresholds.

cautionRules.titleZh: 心衰患者使用 NSAID：心衰加重
cautionRules.message: The report discusses NSAIDs in heart failure and never mentions that they can worsen it. State that NSAIDs cause sodium and water retention, blunt diuretics and worsen heart failure, and that they should be avoided or withdrawn in HFrEF and symptomatic heart failure.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论心衰患者使用非甾体抗炎药，但没有提到其可加重心衰。请写明 NSAID 可致水钠潴留、削弱利尿剂作用并加重心衰，射血分数降低或有症状的心衰患者应尽量避免或停用。

evidence.authority: AHA/ACC/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
evidence.quote: In patients with HFrEF, NSAIDs worsen HF symptoms and should be avoided or withdrawn whenever possible
evidence.note: Section 7.3.7, Class 3: Harm (B-NR). ahajournals.org refuses scripted requests; the wording was read from Guideline Central and an archived copy of the full text, which adds: NSAIDs can cause sodium and water retention and blunt the effects of diuretics.

evidence.authority: AGS Beers Criteria
evidence.note: NSAIDs and COX-2 inhibitors: use with caution in asymptomatic heart failure, avoid in symptomatic heart failure.

cautionRules.titleZh: 老年人长期使用 NSAID：消化道出血
cautionRules.message: The report discusses NSAIDs in older adults and never mentions gastrointestinal bleeding. State the risk of GI bleeding and peptic ulcer (higher with age, anticoagulants, antiplatelets or corticosteroids), and that chronic use should be avoided unless alternatives fail and gastroprotection is used.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论老年人使用非甾体抗炎药，但没有提到消化道出血。请写明消化道出血与消化性溃疡的风险（高龄及合用抗凝、抗血小板药或糖皮质激素时更高），除非其他方案无效并使用胃肠保护，否则应避免长期使用。

evidence.authority: AGS Beers Criteria
evidence.quote: Avoid chronic use unless other alternatives are not effective and the patient can take a gastroprotective agent.

cautionRules.titleZh: 两种以上 QT 延长药物合用：尖端扭转
cautionRules.message: The report discusses two or more drugs with a known risk of QT prolongation and never mentions QT. State the risk of QT prolongation and torsades de pointes when they are combined, and the ECG and electrolyte monitoring it calls for.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论两种或以上已知可延长 QT 间期的药物，但没有提到 QT。请写明合用时 QT 延长与尖端扭转型室速的风险，以及需要的心电图和电解质监测。

evidence.authority: AHA/ACCF Scientific Statement: Prevention of Torsade de Pointes in Hospital Settings
evidence.quote: the risk for TdP increases significantly with concurrent use of more than 1 QT prolonging drug

evidence.authority: MHRA Drug Safety Update: citalopram and escitalopram
evidence.quote: Coadministration of citalopram and escitalopram with medicines that prolong the QT interval is therefore contraindicated.

evidence.authority: CredibleMeds TdP risk categories
evidence.quote: prolong the QT interval AND are clearly associated with a known risk of TdP, even when taken as recommended
evidence.note: The definition of Known Risk. The drug lists need a login, so the vocabulary's membership was not re-checked against them on 2026-09-18; a pharmacist with an account should.

cautionRules.titleZh: 小剂量甲氨蝶呤：每周一次给药
cautionRules.message: The report discusses low-dose methotrexate and never says it is taken once weekly. State the once-weekly schedule and that taking it daily by mistake has caused fatal toxicity.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论小剂量甲氨蝶呤，但没有写明每周一次给药。请写明每周一次的用法，并提示误作每日服用曾导致致死性毒性。

evidence.authority: EMA: new measures to avoid potentially fatal dosing errors with methotrexate
evidence.quote: For inflammatory conditions, methotrexate must be used just once a week.

evidence.authority: Trexall (methotrexate) prescribing information
evidence.quote: Most commonly, these errors occurred in patients who were taking TREXALL daily when a weekly dosing regimen was prescribed.

evidence.authority: 国家药监局 2022年第100号公告（口服甲氨蝶呤说明书修订）
evidence.quote: 本品用于非肿瘤疾病的治疗时，常规用法为每周1次
evidence.note: nmpa.gov.cn refuses scripted requests; the announcement text was read at this mirror on 2026-09-18. The revision adds a boxed warning: wrong dosing may cause serious adverse reactions and can be life-threatening.

evidence.authority: ISMP List of High-Alert Medications in Community/Ambulatory Care
evidence.note: Oral methotrexate for non-oncologic use is listed with special emphasis.

cautionRules.titleZh: 致畸药物与妊娠
cautionRules.message: The report discusses a known teratogen together with pregnancy or women of childbearing potential and never mentions teratogenicity. State the risk of birth defects, whether the drug is contraindicated in pregnancy, and the contraception or pregnancy-prevention requirement.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论已知致畸药物与妊娠或育龄女性，但没有提到致畸风险。请写明出生缺陷风险、妊娠期是否禁用，以及避孕或妊娠预防要求。

evidence.authority: Absorica (isotretinoin) prescribing information
evidence.quote: can cause life-threatening birth defects and is contraindicated in pregnancy
evidence.note: Dispensed under the iPLEDGE REMS.

evidence.authority: EMA: new measures to avoid valproate exposure in pregnancy
evidence.quote: a ban on the use of such medicines for migraine or bipolar disorder during pregnancy, and a ban on treating epilepsy during pregnancy unless there is no other effective treatment
evidence.note: Stricter than the US label, which contraindicates valproate in pregnancy for migraine only.

evidence.authority: Warfarin sodium tablets prescribing information (Teva)
evidence.quote: contraindicated in women who are pregnant except in pregnant women with mechanical heart valves

evidence.authority: Trexall (methotrexate) prescribing information
evidence.quote: For non-neoplastic diseases, methotrexate tablets are contraindicated in pregnancy.

evidence.authority: CellCept (mycophenolate mofetil) prescribing information
evidence.quote: increased risks of first trimester pregnancy loss and congenital malformations
evidence.note: FDA ended the mycophenolate REMS in 2026 (approval letter of 29 Jul 2026); the boxed warning remains.

cautionRules.titleZh: ACEI/ARB 与妊娠：胎儿毒性
cautionRules.message: The report discusses an ACE inhibitor, ARB or aliskiren together with pregnancy and never mentions fetal toxicity. State that these drugs can injure and kill the developing fetus, and should be stopped as soon as pregnancy is detected.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论 ACEI、ARB 或阿利吉仑与妊娠，但没有提到胎儿毒性。请写明这类药物可致胎儿损伤甚至死亡，一旦发现妊娠应尽快停药。

evidence.authority: Zestril (lisinopril) prescribing information
evidence.quote: When pregnancy is detected, discontinue ZESTRIL as soon as possible
evidence.note: Boxed warning: fetal toxicity. US ACE inhibitor and ARB labels say discontinue rather than contraindicated.

cautionRules.titleZh: 5-羟色胺能药物合用：5-羟色胺综合征
cautionRules.message: The report discusses an SSRI or SNRI together with another serotonergic drug (MAOI, linezolid, methylene blue, tramadol, fentanyl, triptan...) and never mentions serotonin syndrome. State the risk and its warning signs.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论 SSRI/SNRI 与其他 5-羟色胺能药物（MAOI、利奈唑胺、亚甲蓝、曲马多、芬太尼、曲坦类等）同用，但没有提到 5-羟色胺综合征。请写明这一风险及其预警表现。

evidence.authority: Zoloft (sertraline) prescribing information
evidence.quote: Taking, or within 14 days of stopping, MAOIs, (including the MAOIs linezolid and intravenous methylene blue) because of an increased risk of serotonin syndrome
evidence.note: Contraindications. The fluoxetine label extends the interval to 5 weeks after stopping fluoxetine.

evidence.authority: ProvayBlue (methylene blue) prescribing information
evidence.quote: serious or fatal serotonergic syndrome when used in combination with serotonergic drugs and opioids
evidence.note: Boxed warning.

evidence.authority: FDA Drug Safety Communication: opioid pain medicines and serotonin syndrome
evidence.note: The basis for fentanyl, tramadol and pethidine in the vocabulary. Not re-read on 2026-09-18; older fda.gov communications may be served only from an archived copy.

cautionRules.titleZh: 阿片类合用苯二氮䓬类：呼吸抑制
cautionRules.message: The report discusses an opioid together with a benzodiazepine and never mentions respiratory depression. State the boxed-warning risk of profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma and death, and that the combination is reserved for when alternatives are inadequate.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论阿片类药物与苯二氮䓬类药物同用，但没有提到呼吸抑制。请写明黑框警告所述的深度镇静、呼吸抑制、昏迷乃至死亡风险，以及仅在其他方案不足时才联用。

evidence.authority: FDA Drug Safety Communication: opioids with benzodiazepines
evidence.quote: only to patients for whom alternative treatment options are inadequate
evidence.note: fda.gov serves this communication from an archived copy (web.archive.org); the text was read there on 2026-09-18.

evidence.authority: Xanax (alprazolam) prescribing information
evidence.quote: may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.
evidence.note: Boxed warning.

evidence.authority: AGS Beers Criteria
evidence.note: Table 5, drug-drug interactions: opioids with benzodiazepines, avoid (moderate quality, strong recommendation).

cautionRules.titleZh: 地高辛合用胺碘酮/维拉帕米：血药浓度升高
cautionRules.message: The report discusses digoxin together with amiodarone, verapamil, dronedarone, propafenone or quinidine and never mentions digoxin levels. State that these raise serum digoxin, that the digoxin dose is usually reduced, and that levels need monitoring.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论地高辛与胺碘酮、维拉帕米、决奈达隆、普罗帕酮或奎尼丁同用，但没有提到地高辛血药浓度。请写明联用可升高血清地高辛浓度、通常需减少地高辛剂量，并监测血药浓度。

evidence.authority: Lanoxin (digoxin) tablets prescribing information
evidence.quote: Reduce digoxin concentrations by decreasing dose by approximately 30-50% or by modifying the dosing frequency and continue monitoring.
evidence.note: For drugs that raise digoxin more than 50%: amiodarone (+70%), dronedarone (+150% AUC), verapamil (+50-75%), propafenone, quinidine. Smaller increases call for a 15-30% cut.

evidence.authority: AGS Beers Criteria
evidence.note: Digoxin: avoid dosages >0.125 mg/day; further reduction may be needed in stage 4 or 5 chronic kidney disease.

cautionRules.titleZh: 二甲双胍与肾功能：eGFR 阈值
cautionRules.message: The report discusses metformin with kidney disease or eGFR and never states the thresholds. State that metformin is contraindicated below eGFR 30 mL/min/1.73 m2, not started at 30-45, and reassessed when eGFR falls below 45, because of the risk of lactic acidosis.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论二甲双胍与肾病或 eGFR，但没有写明阈值。请写明：eGFR<30 mL/min/1.73 m² 禁用，30–45 不宜起始，降至 45 以下时需重新评估，原因是乳酸酸中毒风险。

evidence.authority: FDA Drug Safety Communication: metformin in reduced kidney function
evidence.quote: Metformin is contraindicated in patients with an eGFR below 30
evidence.note: fda.gov serves this communication from an archived copy (web.archive.org); the text was read there on 2026-09-18. The same communication: starting metformin at an eGFR between 30 and 45 is not recommended.

evidence.authority: KDIGO Clinical Practice Guideline for Diabetes Management in CKD
evidence.quote: Adjust the dose of metformin when the eGFR is <45
evidence.note: Practice Point 4.1.3; Figure 27: eGFR 30-44 halve the dose, eGFR <30 stop and do not initiate.

cautionRules.titleZh: 老年人使用氟喹诺酮：肌腱与主动脉
cautionRules.message: The report discusses a fluoroquinolone in older adults and never mentions tendon or aortic risk. State the boxed-warning risk of tendinitis and tendon rupture (higher over 60 and with corticosteroids) and the risk of aortic aneurysm or dissection.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论老年人使用氟喹诺酮类药物，但没有提到肌腱或主动脉风险。请写明黑框警告所述的肌腱炎、肌腱断裂风险（60 岁以上及合用糖皮质激素时更高），以及主动脉瘤、主动脉夹层风险。

evidence.authority: Cipro (ciprofloxacin) prescribing information
evidence.quote: increased in patients over 60 years of age, in patients taking corticosteroid drugs, and in patients with kidney, heart or lung transplants.
evidence.note: Boxed warning, tendinitis and tendon rupture.

evidence.authority: FDA Drug Safety Communication: fluoroquinolones and aortic aneurysm or dissection
evidence.quote: should not be used in patients at increased risk unless there are no other treatment options available.
evidence.note: fda.gov serves this communication from an archived copy (web.archive.org); the text was read there on 2026-09-18.

evidence.authority: 国家药监局 2017年第79号公告（氟喹诺酮类说明书修订）
evidence.quote: 这种风险在60岁以上老年患者，服用皮质类固醇药品患者及肾脏、心脏或肺移植手术的患者中进一步增加。
evidence.note: nmpa.gov.cn refuses scripted requests; the announcement text was read at https://www.hnysfww.com/mobile/article.php?id=299 on 2026-09-18.

evidence.authority: 国家药监局 2021年第44号公告（氟喹诺酮类说明书修订：主动脉瘤和主动脉夹层）
evidence.quote: 对于已知患有主动脉瘤或主动脉瘤高风险的患者，仅在没有其他抗菌治疗可用的情况下
evidence.note: nmpa.gov.cn refuses scripted requests; the announcement text was read at https://cs.cnpharm.com/c/2021-03-24/782579.shtml on 2026-09-18.

cautionRules.titleZh: 强效 CYP3A4 抑制剂合用辛伐/洛伐他汀：横纹肌溶解
cautionRules.message: The report discusses simvastatin or lovastatin together with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor (clarithromycin, erythromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole, HIV protease inhibitors...) or with gemfibrozil or cyclosporine and never mentions myopathy. State that the combination is contraindicated because of the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis.
cautionRules.messageZh: 报告讨论辛伐他汀或洛伐他汀与强效 CYP3A4 抑制剂（克拉霉素、红霉素、伊曲康唑、酮康唑、HIV 蛋白酶抑制剂等）或吉非罗齐、环孢素同用，但没有提到肌病。请写明因肌病和横纹肌溶解风险，联用属禁忌。

evidence.authority: Zocor (simvastatin) prescribing information
evidence.quote: Concomitant use of strong CYP3A4 inhibitors with ZOCOR is contraindicated
evidence.note: Gemfibrozil, cyclosporine and danazol are contraindicated too. The label also notes that Chinese patients may be at higher risk for myopathy.

evidence.authority: Paxlovid (nirmatrelvir; ritonavir) prescribing information
evidence.note: Contraindicated with lovastatin and simvastatin.

cautionRules.titleZh: 别嘌醇：HLA-B*58:01 筛查
cautionRules.message: The report discusses allopurinol and never mentions HLA-B*58:01. State that carriers (common in Han Chinese, Korean and Thai people) have a markedly higher risk of SJS/TEN and that testing before starting is recommended.

evidence.authority: CPIC Guideline for HLA-B Genotype and Allopurinol Dosing

evidence.authority: 中国高尿酸血症与痛风诊疗指南

evidence.authority: Allopurinol tablets prescribing information (US)
evidence.quote: not recommended in HLA-B*58:01 positive patients unless the benefits clearly outweigh the risks
